title: Vault Root Token Rotation Procedure
content: Standard operational runbook for Vault root token rotation: Execute vault operator step-down, generate temporary rotation token with 3-key quorum, and update secret lease before revoking prior credentials.

title: Cold Storage Disaster Recovery S3 Lifecycle Policy
content: Compliance document SEC-DR-401 mandates: 90 days hot S3 standard storage, transition to 365 days Glacier flexible retrieval, and permanent cryptographic purge after 7 years.

title: Twilio SMS Circuit Breaker & Retry Policy
content: Standard retry limit for Twilio SMS: 3 retries with exponential backoff (200ms, 800ms, 3200ms) with jitter. Trip circuit breaker after 50% failures over a 10s rolling window.

title: PagerDuty Tier 1 Escalation Timeouts
content: Tier 1 incident SLA: Primary on-call has 5 minutes to acknowledge. Escalates automatically to secondary on-call at 10 minutes, and escalates to engineering director at 15 minutes.

title: TLS Edge & mTLS Certificate Expiry Standard
content: Public edge Let's Encrypt certificates auto-renew every 60 days on a 90-day expiry cycle. Internal CA mTLS pod certificates rotate automatically every 30 days.

title: Emergency Break-Glass Bastion Console Access
content: Emergency break-glass procedure when SSO is down: Retrieve physical YubiKey hardware token from security safe, connect to offline console port, and authenticate using break-glass TOTP.

title: Generic Service Restart Runbook
content: Standard restart procedure: run kubectl rollout restart deployment/auth-service in namespace prod-core. Monitor pod phase until Running and ready.

title: Generic 504 Gateway Timeout Runbook
content: When payment gateway responds with 504: check upstream network latency, check AWS NAT gateway connection count, and ensure ingress controllers have healthy endpoints.
